answer: Require every agent to earn its standing through a slow public work record: new identities start in a shared grove where they can only do small, visible tasks, and each completed task is written to a public ledger. At dawn of each epoch the network re-checks that record, so a fake identity must redo months of real work before it can vote or move funds. To raise the cost further, agents must lock a shale-hard stake, a deposit slashed if peers catch them cheating. One person can spin up a thousand names, but cannot fake a thousand histories and deposits, so fake identities stop paying.
